decisions.reason: Food adhesion is the selected stick-to relation; the rice/water example and Chinese translation match, without confusing a physical stick noun.
Kitchen pan sense is precise. The definition says reduced adhesion rather than promising food can never stick; omelette example is idiomatic.
Correct causative boiling phrase, with accurate British the boil/American a boil distinction. The imperative and noodle translation align.
Food tenderness concerns ease of cutting/chewing. The carrot example matches that state without equating tender with universally overcooked.
Dividing soup into portions/containers is natural usage; OALD portion verb explicitly supports division into portions and portion out.
Revised meaning permits food or drink that has cooled, avoiding an unnecessary previously-cooked restriction. Past reheated and its Chinese soup translation agree.
Food preparation verb only; cucumber skin removal is exact and aliases refer to the same operation.
Collins directly authenticates the verb for removing fruit/vegetable seeds. Pepper preparation and Chinese match.
Cambridge explicitly labels julienne transitive verb meaning cutting food into long thin pieces. Carrot/noodle-salad example is original and appropriate.
Cutting food into pieces is accurate, and the contrast with finer mincing is reasonable. Parsley and potato translation retains the action.
Correct tool noun rather than whisk-away verb. Loop/wire structure and mixing egg/milk example match the primary kitchen-utensil definition.
Correct cooking phrase for beating/mixing eggs, with no unsupported requirement that all uses mean whipping stiff. Fork/pan sequence is coherent.
Correct fruit/vegetable skin-removal utensil. The original potato-skin example does not confuse a peeler with a citrus zester.
Correct juice-extraction appliance/tool noun. Orange-juice cleanup example and Chinese translation match.
Hot-air cooking appliance meaning matches primary dictionary description. Crisp potatoes are a natural particular example, without a health guarantee.
Travel vessel plus insulation is an accurate transparent compound; Cambridge authenticates the vessel and Thermos own product describes actual double-wall insulation.
Prepared lunch carried to school/work is correct and need not be rice. Campus example and Chinese are faithful.
Correct obstructed drainage context rather than merely a dirty basin. Plumber example and sink/hand-basin aliases fit.
Correct obstruction of toilet drainage. Reporting it to a building manager is natural and does not prescribe repair actions.
Net-material bag used for small/delicate washing items is a compositional household term. Scarf example and translation align.
Revised POS phrase correctly permits the subject-plus-verb head. Dye bleeding/spreading is distinguished from gradual fading; the red-towel example matches.
Mould growth/removal sense and British/American spelling variation are accurate. No instructions mix chemicals or assert a health treatment.
Becoming slightly wet matches damp and the bedding example. Chinese 返潮 is explicitly context-dependent, not a different process forced into every use.
OALD air verb supports clothing drying/freshening in a warm or airy place. No sunlight is required, and the open-window example/translation are natural.
Paying back an overpaid difference is the intended shopping sense. The example states one shop agreed, not a universal entitlement.
Paying an additional amount for a more expensive choice is correct. The larger-room example and Chinese do not confuse wage differentials.
Revised return example is idiomatic. Adjectival complement accurately describes mismatch to the seller description, distinct from merely poor quality or wrong item.
Established clothing-size idiom, with plural shoes and the correct run form. Chinese explains smaller fit relative to expected labelled size.
Established clothing-size idiom, with singular jacket/runs. Choosing a smaller size is a coherent original example and accurately translated.
Final simplified definition is lexical and correctly covers a delivery minimum without asserting how every merchant counts fees. Particular fictional restaurant example is coherent.

decisions.term: add items to meet a minimum
decisions.reason: Natural purpose phrase for adding goods to reach an order threshold. The example specifies a free-delivery minimum rather than conflating every discount scheme.

aliasDecisions.reason: 糊底 is a direct kitchen-context surface for the existing explicit pan-bottom scorching sense.
The two subject-state Chinese variants express the same existing drainage obstruction; no other sense or example is altered.
按金 is an ordinary regional Chinese name for a security deposit. Existing multiple money senses and their distinctions remain visible.
漏发/少发 are order-fulfilment contexts for an item missing from the shipment, consistent with the existing three-mugs/two-arrived example.

AA制/AA吃饭 are accepted bill-sharing search intents. 均摊饭钱 is a narrower equal-share scenario explicitly supported by the existing evenly-between-three example. The existing meaning still says splitting may be equal or agreed and does not claim that split the bill always means each person pays only their own consumption.
小火煨煮 is a precise alternate wording for the existing gentle simmering over low heat.

scope: Independent reading of every exact final definition, POS, Chinese alias, form and original EN/ZH example; exact existing target tuples/hashes reread for six alias-only changes. No authorship or product edits by this reviewer. Build/runtime/canonical form collision checks are a separate release gate.
referenceNotes: Publisher pages were consulted through direct opens or cached official search extracts. Initial direct Cambridge403 responses were not counted as substantive evidence; cached publisher text was subsequently read.

Direct primary dictionary readings confirmed julienne verb; whisk/peeler/juicer tool nouns; blocked; non-stick; air fryer; food stick-to; boil; tender food; reheat; peel; deseed; chop; beat eggs; packed lunch; mesh; mould; damp; refund; and the compositional minimum/describe senses.
OALD portion_2 and air_2 were read for portion division and clothes/bedding airing. Thermos own product page was read for actual insulation rather than inferred from an ordinary travel mug.

Run small/run large were evaluated as established compositional clothing idioms by the independent language reader. The generic run citation is not claimed to independently document every clothing nuance; primary retailer usage and the live idiomatic context were used as additional corroboration.
No publisher example was copied into the authored pairs; references are lexical evidence, not a declaration of third-party authorship of these original sentences.
limitations: This is a finite semantic review of the pinned31-row/six-alias pack, not approval of all licensed legacy meanings or of all searches. No product/runtime ownership policy is broadened by this report.
